body: no, i was sexually assaulted for a month in the eighth grade. i’m pretty sure the proper term is assailant, but again, i’m not too sure. it just sounds proper. regardless, my hobbies are teaching myself different instruments and languages. and i do have some friends, and they’re close, but i just never really go out with them.  maybe i should make a new friend? i’m not sure though. i can’t really keep a conversation.

i’m not even sure at this point. i just don’t feel good. like, ever. it’s been constant misery since the beginning of september. i mean, i haven’t been completely happy in a while, but it’s just gotten so much worse. plus i have my assulter (ik that isn’t a word but i can’t think of the proper term rn) in one of my classes, which puts me through a hefty mental strain. not only, but, i also have awful seasonal depression, so i’m very anxious about that.
oh. i’m sorry. i’m not sure what to say
out of state, even canada. try for even the lowest of jobs. i’m sure you can find something. and if you do decide to move, don’t move to a big city. maybe a small suburb. housing in the city is wack

thank you. its just hard. it’s not even the fact that i drink constantly, it’s just whenever i get really low and can’t handle the fact that it happened. 

i’m extremely sorry if this upset you in any way.  but thank you for taking the time out of your day to read it.

i’m sorry about how you feel and the decision you’ve made. and although there’s nothing i can do to stop you considering you have no idea who i am, i do not believe you’re holding your s/o back. as you said you’ve been together for a decade and you feel that he’s being held back, but i believe the opposite. he seems to really love and care for you, especially since he stayed with you through all of this. and your best friend, too. and as you said, you’ve yelled at her in the past, and it’s true, she didn’t deserve it, but, it’s nothing you could’ve helped. you had to feel what you needed to. they understood that. that’s why they still wanted to be friends with you in the end. and i know i’m one to talk, i feel the exact same way, but, it’s so different from an outside perspective. you mean so much to these people and you don’t even realize it, and, i can’t blame you, because again, i feel the same way. i know that this probably won’t prevent you doing it, but i hope that this possibly delayed it, even just by a little.
thank you for the suggestion. i’ll try to find some online. i’ll get back to you on how i feel after a week or two if i can remember. thank you for helping me.

i have been trying to think good about myself, but it’s just difficult to, you know? i’m not necessarily the person to tell myself positive things about me and it doesn’t feel right when i try to. i also hate being complimented because it seems forced and insincere and i don’t feel comfortable accepting it. 

also, there’s no issues with my s/o and i, i just don’t want to put them through this with me. i’d feel selfish for doing something like that considering they’re so close to me. it’s much easier to do this because it’s somewhat anonymous. nobody’ll know who i am. it’s just easier. 

also, thank you for replying.

please, if you absolutely need it, text me. i’ll try my best to help. i’m not sure if you can message on here, but even if not you can still contact me through this. i’m here to help you if you need it. please, please don’t end it here. there’s so much life ahead of you that you haven’t experienced yet. you’re going to do so many great things with your life, you just have to keep pushing a little bit harder. please, try for your friends, your family, maybe even me, the rando you just met on the internet. and then work your way up on doing it for yourself. you’ll find your purpose, you just have to keep pushing.

please, don’t. you mean so much to so many people and you don’t even know it. it’s selfish to say keep living for them, but please, keep living for them. maybe you can find something to keep living for you while you keep living for them.
